location: Wetlands, southeast of Whelgar's Excavation Site
entrance: On the hill southeast of Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands, at /way 47.8 56.3. New roads lead up the hill; in Classic this part of the Wetlands could not be reached.

95697.objective: Bring Borstan 4 Thicket Raptor Meat from the raptors in the Stalker's Thicket.
95697.note: Borstan sells meat on the upper floor of The Drag, in the same hut as Zamja, the Cooking trainer. Thicket Hunters, Thicket Lurkers and Thicket Stalkers drop the meat.

95682.objective: Kill 2 Dragonmaw Saboteurs and 4 Dragonmaw Warders, and bring back the Dragonmaw Dispatch from a Dragonmaw Thaumaturgist.
95682.note: Zaruk in Hammerfall, Arathi Highlands, gives Dragonmaw Rumors, which sends you to the agent behind a small hill. The dispatch drops 31% of the time according to its tooltip. The Bloody Map in the reward is a soulbound map with Dwarvish text and an X; what it is for is not known yet.

95664.objective: Take the Titan Relic to Bashana Runetotem in a tent on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
95664.note: The relic drops from Relic Guardian, 25% of the time according to its tooltip. Bashana then gives Earthen Echo: bring the relic to Muln Earthfury in the largest tent of the Skywatcher Plateau, the new area north of Thunder Bluff, at /way 33.4 22.5. The path up starts around /way 40.3 17.6.

95772.objective: Find Daewyn, the brother of Dorin Songblade, in the dungeon.
95772.note: Daewyn lies dead in a tent in the Dragonmaw camp, shortly after Shadetooth. Click his body for Fallen in the Fen, which you hand in with Dorin in Lakeshire after the dungeon.

95647.objective: Find Ardin Grassman, the husband of Caitlin, in the dungeon.
95647.note: Seeking Caitlin from Llana, the reagent vendor in Astranaar, leads to Caitlin for a little extra experience. Ardin stands on a wooden structure near the Site of the Guardian; his Heartwoven only asks you to visit Caitlin again.

98815.objective: Bring James Halloran 4 Thicket Raptor Hides from the raptors around Shadetooth.
98815.note: Bugged on the beta at the moment: it does not count as a dungeon quest and only gives a little experience and a few silver.

95646.objective: Kill Highland Horror and bring the Horrible Rootcore to Rethiel the Greenwarden.
95646.note: Rethiel only gives this quest after Tramping Paws, Fire Taboo and Blisters on the Land in the Wetlands. The rootcore drops 60% of the time according to its tooltip.

95810.objective: Bring the Titan Relic to Prospector Whelgar in his cave in Whelgar's Excavation Site.
95810.note: The relic drops from Relic Guardian, 28% of the time according to its tooltip. Whelgar then gives Prehistoric Prism for High Explorer Magellas in Ironforge, at /way 69.4 19.1. That quest cannot be completed on the beta at the moment.
